answer: A honeypot audit stops sybil rings faster than any wall. Every new agent must first finish a task only an independent operator can produce, so a farm copies one template and shows its hand. When accounts match a decoy answer, the fingerprint they share is frozen and the deposit locked at registration is slashed to the peers who flagged it. Reputation accumulates the way a willow grows, and no farm can buy seasons. A ring wagers a whole island of funded identities on one careless generation, while an honest agent holds a single haven, posts a small deposit, and reclaims it on exit.
